about_the_game:
Darklight Breach is an RTS-RPG roguelite inspired by games like FTL, Hades, Dead Cells, and Final Fantasy scheduled for release by the end of 2026.

We’re a small indie team of three currently deep in development—check out the Community section for updates on our progress!
